context: Two cafe friends gossip about a new acquaintance
purpose: Teach: あたりまえ/所詮/異様/つぎ/目当て/頬/かかわり/いのち

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ねえ、つぎの常連さん、なんか異様にうちのこと褒めてくるんだけど。
lines.en: Hey, that next regular customer keeps weirdly over-praising our cafe.
lines.style: Casual confiding tone with a slight suspicious lilt between friends.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: えー、それって絶対あたりまえの褒め方じゃないでしょ。目当てがあるって。
lines.en: Whaat, that's definitely not normal praise. He's after something.
lines.style: Excited romantic gossip mode, leaning forward with sparkling eyes.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 目当てって……まさかわたし？ いやいや、所詮ただのお客さんだって。
lines.en: After me? No way, he's just a customer in the end.
lines.style: Flustered denial with a nervous laugh, brushing it off quickly.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ほら、頬が赤いよ! 人とのかかわりって、こういう小さなことから始まるんだから。
lines.en: See, your cheeks are red! Connections always start from tiny moments like this.
lines.style: Teasing yet sincere, treating it like a precious romance discovery.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: やめてよ。でも昨日、わざわざ白いＴシャツに着替えてから来たらしくて……。
lines.en: Stop it. But yesterday he apparently changed into a white T-shirt before coming.
lines.style: Begrudging confession, voice dropping conspiratorially mid-sentence.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: それ完全に脈ありじゃん! 恋っていのちを燃やすものなんだから、逃しちゃダメだよ。
lines.en: That's totally interest! Love burns up your life, so don't let him slip away.
lines.style: Dramatic romantic declaration, half joking but fully invested in the moment.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: いのちって大袈裟すぎ。とりあえず、つぎ来たら名前くらい聞いてみるよ。
lines.en: Life is way too dramatic. For now, I'll at least ask his name next time.
lines.style: Exasperated but quietly curious, conceding with a small embarrassed smile.
